messages:
Dana W: quick brainstorm: need a smooth per-route v1 deprec flow that avoids quota shocks. thinking: preview (no billing) -> staged -> cutover. simple UI and clear telemetry.
Omar L: agree. preview should be a sampled simulation only. do NOT count toward hard quotas. show median + CI for cost delta.
Priya S: telemetry names proposal: deprec.preview.cost_median, deprec.preview.cost_p10, deprec.live.cost_delta. tag with route_id and tenant_id. also add deprec.cohort=control|preview|live.
Theo M: router sketch: check X-Client-Version, then route.deprec_state. if preview -> sample to v2 for analysis and route primary to v1. staged -> gradual weight stepping with pause/revert hooks.
Dana W: console UX: banner "v2 available 30 Preview cost & quality". clicking runs preview job (0.1%/1%/5%). show top contributing endpoints and redacted samples.
deprecation-bot: NOTE: enabling preview emits audit event route.deprecation.preview.started and creates a temp dashboard.
Omar L: alerts: auto-pause staged if p95 delta > 50ms or quality regression > 2% for 15m. ops notified and incident opened.
Priya S: privacy: redact outputs; keep prompt hashes + metadata. allow tenant opt-out of storing samples.
Dana W: action items: Omar -> router sampling prototype, Priya -> RFC for metric names, Theo -> console mock. target alpha behind flag in 3 weeks.
Theo M: will spike router logic this week and post link.
Dana W: end.
